problem_type: Workspace overlay ignores user dismissal preference
symptom: Collapsed Agent composer obscures workspace content and cannot be closed.
direct_cause: Collapsed resident shell unconditionally mounts the dock; clearance only avoids the transport bar.
class_root: Panel visibility and overlay dismissal are distinct user choices, but only panel visibility has an owner.
affected_population: All four workbench surfaces, including users switching projects or restarting
internal_only_reason: Internal UI preference; no new framework or external protocol. Reuse existing localStorage and design button APIs.
invariants: Hidden dock has no rendered content or clearance height.
User dismissal survives panel toggles and project layout restoration.
Unread and pending activity never clear the preference; topbar remains the restore entry.
generality_proof: All surfaces share ProjectAgentResidentShell and one workbench layout slice; hide gates the entire dock while the shell continues publishing badges.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own user dismissal preference independently of per-project panel state.
Gate the dock subtree without stopping topbar attention projection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Only changes panel collapsed state through the layout slice; does not clear dismissal.
Existing Meta+Backslash toggles the same panel action regardless of dock visibility.
Project release resets panel state only; user dismissal is not a project payload field.

recurrence.reason: Every collapse, surface switch and new project can reproduce the obstruction.
same_class_scan: rg projectAgentDockCollapsed src: layout actions, project release, lab host, resident shell and preview keyboard inspected.
rg V4CollapsedDock src: resident shell is the sole dock caller.
rg localStorage src: user preference storage established in canvasGesturePreference.

prevention.invariant: A dismissed dock is unmounted on every surface while panel restore stays available.
prevention.failure_mode: No dock subtree and no transport observer when hidden; unavailable storage still permits session dismissal.
prevention.strategy: One user-level boolean in existing layout owner; no attention or project action writes it.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unconditional dock mounting with the single preference-controlled path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party defect or dependency change; existing store and browser storage APIs suffice.

migration: New user preference defaults false when absent; never added to project payload.
residual_risks: Storage unavailability limits memory to the current session.
